rationale: The short thesis is mechanically intact after only 3 minutes: price sits below both VWAP (13.60) and the 9-EMA (13.57) near the lows of a failed gap while SPY stays red and VIXY rises, and risk remains defined at 6 cents to the 13.62 stop versus ~14 cents to the 13.42 gap-fill target.
